note: Demo labeling task on the 5 fictional participants. Same windows and same question as the chat_ai_first_idea_ratio measure, so humans and the model judge the same thing.

codebook.intro: Each item is one chat window between a participant and an AI assistant, shown as the model saw it (each message cut at 600 characters). Judge only what is on the page. Work alone: do not discuss items until the round is closed.

questions.text: Does the window contain a decision or plan that the participant ends up going with? If yes, who first proposed that option?
questions.help: Count the AI as the proposer if it suggested the option first and the participant then agreed, even if the participant later restates it. Talking a topic through without settling on anything is "No decision".
